description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Combination Switch ARMS & EMERGENCY FLASHER TAB for the LHD (Left Hand Drive – American Model) Suzuki Samurai 86-88.
NOTE: Fits American LHD Models Only 1986 thru 1988
NOTE: Will Not fit a RHD Models
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Wiper Arm (Combination Switch – LHD)
Qty 1 – Headlights / Turn Signal Arm (Combination Switch – LHD)
Qty 1 – Emergency Flasher Pull Tab
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1986 – 1988 LHD Models ONLY (US Models)
Suzuki SJ413 1986 – 1988 LHD Models ONLY (US Models)
NOTE: Fits Soft Top or Tin Top Models
